name: Nornet
summary: Lismore/Northern Rivers NSW regional dialup + hosting + local directories ISP (nor.com.au live by Nov 1995); run by Norsearch Ltd, the company wholly owned by Southern Cross University, until sold 1999 to the Linear G group; brand folded into LinearG Dec 2014.

events.details: Regional dialup ISP + local directories (Clarence/Richmond/Tweed etc.); nor.com.au homepage counter 'Accessed ... times since 24-Nov-1995'. In the 1997 IP index as NORNET-AU (203.15.154.0/24), NORNET1-AU (203.29.213.0/24) and NORNET2-AU (203.35.123.0/24), registered to 'Norsearch (trading as NORNET)' c/- Southern Cross University, Lismore.

refs.label: IP Network Index 1997: NORNET-AU 203.15.154.0/24 'Norsearch (trading as NORNET) c/- Southern Cross University'
IP Network Index 1997: NORNET1-AU 203.29.213.0/24 'Nornet - Norsearch, Lismore'

events.details: Owned by Norsearch Ltd, the company wholly owned by Southern Cross University; NORNET ran in Norsearch's Communications Division (with the printery and SCU Press). Sold by Norsearch during 1999 to a local consortium that ran the Linear G group (later incorporated as Modulux Pty Ltd), and continued operating under its own name.

refs.label: Southern Cross University Annual Report 1999 (Norsearch Ltd): 'NORNET Internet Service Provider was sold by the company during 1999 to a local consortium'

events.details: Brand folded into Linear G; nor.com.au first archived redirecting to linearg.com 18 Dec 2014.

refs.label: LinearG homepage - began Internet services Jan 2000; 'Since 2010 Linear G has incorporated ... Nornet, Big River Internet, OMCS, and NRG Internet'
